item.title: Concept Art proposal for Kengo Kuma Kamal Theatre Project
item.description: At the beginning of 2022, Kengo Kuma won the international competition for the Kamal Theatre in Kazan. We are honored to participate in it by providing visual representation services. During this pleasant cooperation, our creative planning team created quite some rendering proposal drafts in early stage.
